scope: Opt-in two-job stop/unload, Homebrew package upgrade between two verified candidates, start with a standard Incus marker, then removal stop/unload and brew uninstall, on an isolated state with its own INCUS_CONF, gateway port and hashed labels

sequence.result: both starts ready on the isolated gateway port; marker step failed in the runner (incus list remote:name), state retained
both starts reused the ready runtime; marker instance launched and marker written and read
runtime stopped; server job then runtime job unloaded; only the server plist removed; retained data recorded
brew uninstall old, untap, candidate build new (source build, bottle), uninstall test keg, candidate install new (poured)

ready on the same gateway port; marker read back; disks by identity, settings, server credentials, gateway certificate and client configuration unchanged; server plist re-registered for the new revision; upgrade_available reported and not applied
runtime stopped; both jobs unloaded; both owned plists removed
no job loaded, no owned plist, macus not installed; disks, settings, credentials and client configuration unchanged

isolation.incus_conf: isolated client directory beside the state

runner_fixes_during_run: the isolated state now gets its own gateway port; the first attempt's server crash-looped on eaddrinuse against the default runtime's 8443 and was unloaded with its files kept
the marker is listed as `incus list remote:` and matched by name
default_state_after_run: the machine's default state, created on the old candidate, was upgraded through the same documented sequence and started on the new candidate: ready, server job registered for the new revision, same gateway certificate, its container running, appliance upgrade reported and not applied
